title: One Schedule Does Not Fit All: Adaptive Inference Schedules for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models typically use a fixed denoising schedule across workloads. We show that the cheapest schedule that preserves quality depends on the task, model, and sampler. We propose Task-Calibrated Denoising Allocation (TCDA), a deployment rule with an explicit error guarantee. Given candidate samplers, paired calibration data, a utility tolerance, and guardrails against degeneration, TCDA uses simultaneous one-sided bootstrap bounds to certify which candidates meet both the utility and guardrail criteria. It deploys the cheapest certified candidate or falls back to the full schedule. The probability of deploying an infeasible schedule is asymptotically at most alpha. Candidates include early prefix decoding, state-reusing continuation, reduced time grids, and confidence-threshold decoding. Across seven datasets and two model families, TCDA certifies reductions in denoiser evaluations by factors of 3.4 on XSum and 2.0 on WMT

translated_title: 一种调度无法适用于所有情况：扩散语言模型的自适应推理调度
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通常在所有工作负载中使用固定的去噪调度。我们证明，在保持质量的前提下，最廉价的调度取决于任务、模型和采样器。我们提出了任务校准去噪分配（Task-Calibrated Denoising Allocation，TCDA），这是一种具有显式误差保证的部署规则。给定候选采样器、配对校准数据、效用容忍度以及防止退化的防护措施，TCDA 使用同步单侧自助法界限来认证哪些候选方案同时满足效用和防护标准。它部署经过认证的最廉价候选方案，或回退到完整调度。部署不可行调式的概率渐近地至多为 alpha。候选方案包括早期前缀解码、状态复用续写、缩减时间网格和置信度阈值解码。在七个数据集和两个模型系列上，TCDA 认证了去噪器评估次数的显著减少：在 XSum 上减少 3.4 倍，在 WMT 上减少 2.0 倍。
tldr: 本文提出 TCDA，一种具有显式误差保证的自适应部署规则，可根据任务、模型和采样器为扩散语言模型选择满足质量要求的最低成本推理调度，将去噪器评估次数最多减少 3.4 倍。
en_tdlr: TCDA is a deployment rule with explicit error guarantees that adaptively selects the cheapest certified inference schedule for diffusion language models based on task, model, and sampler, reducing denoiser evaluations by up to 3.4x.
